images.title: Sharing 42 in the ratio 4 : 3
images.purpose: Shows 42 counters arranged as 7 groups of 6, with 4 groups for the partner and 3 for you.
images.composition: Seven equal columns of counters in a row, with a small gap between the fourth and fifth columns, and one label above and one under each side. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: 7 columns, each holding 6 round counters stacked vertically, 42 counters in all. The first 4 columns are teal (#0072B2) counters with the label 'partner 24' under them; the last 3 columns are amber (#E69F00) counters with the label 'you 18' under them. Above all the columns the label '7 groups of 6'. Each column has a thin dark outline colour (#2B2B2B) outline box. Exactly 42 counters, 7 boxes.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Add the terms to get the number of groups, then share the groups.
